podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: Cancel the Apocalypse: Why AI Won’t Kill Us (And How Tokenization Will Save Finance) with Omer Khan
podcasts.description: For nearly four years now, I’ve been sounding the alarm, or at least pacing conference stages with a raised eyebrow about the existential threat of Artificial Intelligence. It started with Eliezer Yudkowsky advising us to unplug the servers before we all get turned into paperclips. Then the "Godfather of AI" himself Geoffrey Hinton, got up in front of a group of us at MIT, the day after he left from his life's work at Google, to warn us about the monster in the basement. Since then, the doomsday clock has felt uncomfortably close to midnight. I’ve always cited that infinite memory, exponential compute, and AI – now autonomous agents, as the key to success or disaster. Now, the threat to humanity feels unnervingly real – Believe it or not, all of this predates, by years, Anthropic and OpenAI sounding the alarm. There’s hope, maybe? Omer, thinks we can all step back from the bunker door. Omer is an absolute crypto OG—if you participated in the ICO boom, there is a literal coin-flip chance you interacted with his code, as he authored roughly 50% of all Solidity ICO smart contracts. He’s also built high-profile digital asset drops for everyone from Snoop Dogg and Grimes to Sir Elton John and Lewis Hamilton. Today, we’re debating whether AI is truly plotting our demise or just choking on bad data, before diving deep into the future of institutional Digital Assets. Here we go!
